name: LinuxCNC oxy-fuel
description: LinuxCNC-style oxy-fuel in millimetres. Absolute moves, cutter compensation and tool length cancelled, path blend G64 P0.05 as on the plasma post, not a measured machine setting. Controller left or right compensation writes G41 or G42 before the first feed and G40 at the end; computed compensation stays on the already-offset path. The cutting flame is a Torch process: on is M3 S1 and off is M5, the same LinuxCNC spindle-control words as plasma. Named Other processes preheat and cutting_oxygen are M64 Pn / M65 Pn; digital_out.preheat_pin and digital_out.cutting_oxygen_pin are post parameters that default to 0 and 1, not machine assignments. Any other Other name is refused. The preheat delay is the path dwell (G4 P in seconds). Arcs use IJK and helices are lines. Height-control words stay empty. process_cycle is per_cut: cutting oxygen, preheat, then torch off before a rapid. A preheat dwell is written only when the IR has one at that cut. No rotary axis. Not proven on a machine.
